import React from 'react';

  color?: string;

export const HomeIcon: React.FC<IconProps> = ({ size = 24, color = "currentColor", className = "" }) => (
  <svg 
    width={size} 
    height={size} 
    viewBox="0 0 24 24" 
    fill="none" 
    className={className}
    style={{ color }}
  >
    <path 
      d="M12 3L2 12H5V20H19V12H22L12 3Z" 
      stroke="currentColor"

      d="M9 20V14H15V20"

);
